rationale: Parent = round 1: recall 0.967 (29/30), false_end_calls 0, quality 0.885, p50 606 / p90 778. A keep needs recall 30/30 with 0 false ends (epsilon 0), or quality above 0.915. The only recall miss is S01, about 1 run in 3: TV/ad audio after 'I'm having trouble understanding.', and the agent restarts the ladder. The response_format ladder fix ended S01 3/3 in rounds 4, 5, 9, 10, 12 and 14, but every such round was reverted on 1-5 false ends. Those came from S36 (disputed; wrong in about a third of runs whatever the edit) and S28 (no-debt goodbye after 'that's my son's', with the round-1 guard text unchanged). So round 1's 0 false ends was very likely luck. Rewording the guards made false ends worse (rounds 2/9/11/16). Temperature 0.0 did not stop the flips (rounds 3/5/8). Rounds 16 and 18 went over p50 700ms after adding only 15-40 words. Quality: reply_quality is scored on 51 rows, so each sample fixed 3/3 adds about +0.015 to quality. Clearing the +0.03 bar would need 3+ of the stuck samples (S02/S04/S05/S09/S15/S19/S21/S23) fixed every run, with no false end and inside the latency limit; no round has managed it. Untried levers don't address this: gateway adds 40-130ms (breaks the p50 limit), temperature 0.7 adds noise, and a 256/512 output cap can't change which action is picked and could truncate call_summary. Another resubmission would be a coin flip, and a keep would come from noise, not a real improvement. Recommendation, unchanged from rounds 15/17/19: re-run the round-1 parent 2-3 times to measure its real false-end rate; resolve the S36 dispute or leave S36 out of false_end_calls; and/or allow false_end_calls epsilon 1 or raise the runs per sample.
